prompts.running:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production transparent game character key-pose master, matching the supplied approved raster mascot exactly.
Input images: Image 1 front, Image 2 three-quarter-right, Image 3 three-quarter-left, Image 4 back; these are the authoritative SAME character model, not inspirations. Preserve their exact recognizable design, proportions, dark navy outline, rose-pink material and softly mottled/stepped surface shading. The character is a compact round pink dango creature with exactly two very short integrated pointed ears, two stubby feet, no separate neck or torso, no tail, and no fur. Keep the tiny short horizontal mouth. Eyes must stay squat black/navy ovals with only one small square white glint per eye; never tall anime eyes, multi-glint eyes, eyelashes or brows. The subtle little upper-back bump just beside the ear in the three-quarter reference is APPROVED anatomy and should survive when that contour is visible.
Rendering: restrained rich soft pink volume within chunky slightly jagged raster edges, matching reference. No smooth vector replacement and no exaggerated coarse pixel-grid restyling. The character has no clothing.
Composition: exactly ONE full-body isolated character and the requested prop if any, large centered on a square transparent RGBA canvas, generous transparent margins, no crop, no floor, no ground shadow, no background fill, no checkerboard, no labels/text, no watermark, no montage, no motion trails. Keep camera height and approximately the reference's apparent scale. Both eyes must remain visible in any turned view; maximum partial three-quarter, never full profile.
Primary request: Change this approved character into a meaningful dynamic RUNNING key pose, travelling toward image right at a modest three-quarter angle. The whole round body leans forward subtly without stretching. One stubby foot reaches forward and the other pushes backward so the two feet read as a real stride, slightly airborne, with natural compact balance. Add only the character's tiny short rounded arms, attached low on its sides, one pumping forward and the other back. Keep limbs very short; do not turn this into a human-shaped runner or create long legs. Preserve both eyes, both short ears, exact tiny mouth and identity. This is a single animation-defining key pose, not the standing body merely rotated or skewed. No prop and no ground effects.
